name: Workflow 5: WhatsApp Review Collection Campaign
description: Automatically requests Google reviews from customers 3 days after purchase/service delivery via WhatsApp

setup_instructions.step_1: Set up a Google Sheet 'Orders' with columns: phone, name, order_date, delivered_date, review_requested, review_received
setup_instructions.step_5: Get your Google Business Profile review link: Go to Google Business Profile → Home → 'Get more reviews' → copy the short URL
setup_instructions.step_6: Schedule this workflow to run daily at 10 AM (Dubai time)

nodes.name: Get Customers Eligible for Review Request
nodes.description: Gets all orders where review hasn't been requested yet and item is delivered

text.body:
Hi {{$json.name}}! 😊

[YOUR BUSINESS NAME] here. We delivered your [ORDER/SERVICE] a few days ago.

We hope you're loving it! 🙏

If you're happy with your experience, could you take 30 seconds to leave us a review? It really helps other customers find us:

⭐ Leave a Google Review:
[YOUR_GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK]

If anything isn't right, please just reply here and we'll fix it immediately.

Thank you so much!
[YOUR NAME]
[BUSINESS NAME]

Hi {{$json.name}}! Quick follow-up 😊

Did you get a chance to try your [PRODUCT/SERVICE]?

Your review means a lot to us and helps other customers:
⭐ [YOUR_GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK]

Or if there's anything we could have done better, just reply here — no pressure at all!

[BUSINESS NAME] Team

nodes.name: Mark Review as Requested in Sheet
Wait 2 Minutes Between Messages
nodes.description: Prevents hitting WhatsApp rate limits when processing many customers

notes: Replace [YOUR_ORDERS_SHEET_ID] with your Google Sheet ID
Replace [YOUR_GOOGLE_REVIEW_LINK] with your Google Business Profile review link
Get Google Review link: Google Business Profile → Home → Get more reviews → copy link
This workflow runs daily — only contacts 3-10 days post-delivery receive messages
Important: Only send to customers who opted in to WhatsApp communications
